items.name: Suthorn cave chest
items.area: Cave east of the Suthorn Prairie waypoint
items.howTo: Enter the cave east of the Suthorn Prairie waypoint, defeat the Ignizol and open the chest at the back.

items.name: Cuccos on the Loose
items.howTo: Side quest reward.

items.name: The Zappy Shipwreck
items.howTo: Side quest reward.

items.name: Thrilling Stamp Card
items.howTo: Collect 15 stamps.

sections.title: Automatons
sections.note: Built by Dampé at his studio in Eastern Hyrule Field; all six unlock the Clockwork Bangle.

items.name: Techtite
items.howTo: 'Automaton Engineer Dampé': show Dampé a Tektite and a Mothula Echo.
items.reward: Jumps on rockets, knocking back nearby enemies

items.name: Tocktorok
items.howTo: 'Explosions Galore!': show an Octorok-type Echo and a Firework.

items.name: Gizmol
items.howTo: 'Performance Artist!': show a Zol-type Echo and bring the Prismatic Music Box (Flag Race).
items.reward: Sings and dances, scattering monsters with music notes

items.name: High-Teku Baba
items.howTo: 'Endless Stomach!': show a Deku Baba Lv. 2 Echo and bring the Steel Trap (Acorn Gathering).

items.name: Roboblin
items.howTo: 'Chop 'em in Two!': show a Sword Moblin Echo and bring the Heirloom Katana (Slumber Dojo).
items.reward: Cuts down groups of enemies with its blade

items.name: Goldfinch
items.howTo: 'Get Rich Quick!': show a Crow Echo and bring the Golden Fan (Mango Rush).
items.reward: Knocks rupees out of enemies; Zelda can glide holding it

sections.title: Outfits
sections.note: 8 outfits from gameplay plus 3 amiibo-only (tagged). Outfits can be changed after Still Missing.

items.name: Disguise
items.howTo: Worn during the escape at the start of the game.

items.name: Royal Travel Attire
items.howTo: Given at the start of 'Lands of the Goddesses' after the Hyrule Castle dungeon.

items.name: Customary Attire
items.howTo: The King returns your dress at the end of the side quest 'From the Heart'.

items.name: Silk Pajamas
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'Dohna's Challenge'.
items.reward: Hearts recover faster while sleeping in a bed

items.name: Dancing Outfit
items.howTo: Mango Rush: harvest 60+ mangoes with Ultimate Seeds.

items.name: Cat Clothes
items.howTo: From the woman by the shop during 'Questioning the Local Cats'.

items.name: Green Tunic
items.howTo: Clear 'The Final Titans' Gathering' within its goal time.

items.name: Stamp Suit
items.howTo: Fill the Final Stamp Card (all 25 stamps).

items.name: Blue Attire
items.howTo: Scan any Princess Zelda or Sheik amiibo.

items.name: Black Cat Clothes
items.howTo: Scan a Ganondorf, Guardian, Bokoblin, Daruk, Mipha, Revali or Urbosa amiibo.

items.name: Red Tunic
items.howTo: Scan any Link amiibo.

sections.title: Mini-games
sections.note: First-clear rewards only. Slumber Dojo has its own tracker; the Goron Race is the side quest 'Ready? Set? Goron!'.

items.name: Mango Rush
items.howTo: Pay Tourma 10 Rupees and spin into the mangoes as they sprout. Each seed type unlocks the next.
items.reward: Golden Fan, 3 Might Crystals, Dancing Outfit, Piece of Heart
items.notes: Golden Fan is needed for 'Get Rich Quick!'. Ultimate Seeds need Still Missing done.

items.name: Flag Race
items.howTo: Talk to Falfa outside the ranch (10 Rupees) and collect the flags in order on horseback. Each course unlocks the next.
items.reward: 3 Might Crystals, Prismatic Music Box, Piece of Heart, Charging Horn
items.notes: Prismatic Music Box is needed for 'Performance Artist!'.

items.name: Acorn Gathering: west of Castle Town
items.area: West of the Hyrule Castle Town wall
items.howTo: Talk to the man in the acorn cap (10 Rupees) and collect every acorn in time.

items.name: Acorn Gathering: northeast of Kakariko
items.howTo: Talk to the man in the acorn cap (10 Rupees) and collect every acorn in time.

items.howTo: Talk to the man in the acorn cap (10 Rupees) and collect every acorn in time.
